title: US EPA FAQSD daily ozone (8-hour maximum) and PM2.5 (daily average) by 2010 census tract, 2013-2019
provider: US EPA, Fused Air Quality Surfaces Using Downscaling (FAQSD), via RSIG
attribution: Credit the US EPA (FAQSD downscaler outputs, RSIG).

terms.summary: Public domain. Downloads come from EPA's server, which does not support resuming and streams at about 0.25 MB/s.

instructions: Download https://ofmpub.epa.gov/rsig/rsigserver?data/FAQSD/outputs/{year}_{kind}.txt.gz for year 2013-2019 and kind ozone_daily_8hour_maximum, pm25_daily_average (14 files, about 6.5 GB compressed).
EPA's server ignores Range requests and streams at about 0.25 MB/s, so each 470 MB file needs one unbroken connection of about 30 minutes; never cap a download below about 3 hours.
gunzip each file into <data_dir>/FAQSD/C4/{year}_{kind}.txt and keep the names exactly as published (about 23.3 GB unpacked).
